title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Explore DePaul University and Chicago with these social activities and spaces that require no admission fees or purchases for students.

cards.title: DePaul Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Park Campus
cards.notes: Visit this teaching museum to see rotating exhibitions of modern and contemporary art. Admission is always free for students and the general public.
cards.short_summary: A university art museum offering free admission to its permanent collection and temporary exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission is free to the public.
cards.source_title: Visit | DePaul Art Museum | DePaul University, Chicago

cards.title: The Quad
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Park Campus
cards.notes: Gather on this central green space for outdoor studying, frisbee, or social events. It is the primary outdoor hub for the Lincoln Park campus community.
cards.short_summary: The central grassy gathering spot on DePaul's Lincoln Park campus used for recreation and events.
cards.evidence_claim: The green, grassy quad... is a favorite spot for students on nice days.
cards.source_title: Quad | Locations | Lincoln Park | Event Management | Student Centers | DePaul University, Chicago
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space; Wi-Fi available for students.

cards.title: Makerspace Crafting
cards.subtitle: Daley Building & SAC
cards.notes: Use 3D printers, laser cutters, and sewing machines for personal or class projects. Materials and equipment training are provided at no cost to students.
cards.short_summary: A student-driven makerspace providing free tools and materials for creative projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The IRL makerspaces provide the tools, materials, workshops and expert guides you need to create personal and class projects.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 10am-8pm; Saturday hours vary by location.

cards.title: Art Institute Free Entry
cards.subtitle: The Loop
cards.notes: Present your valid DePaul ID at the ticket counter for free general admission. It is a popular spot for Loop students to study or explore between classes.
cards.short_summary: DePaul students receive free general admission to one of the world's premier art museums.
cards.evidence_claim: The Art Institute, located mere blocks away from the Loop campus, has free entry for all DePaul students.
cards.source_title: The best DePaul student discounts in Chicago - The DePaulia
cards.access_notes: Requires current DePaul Student ID for free entry.

cards.title: Richardson Library
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Park Campus
cards.notes: Access four floors of study space, including group rooms and quiet zones. Public access is available during the day, while late nights are student-only.
cards.short_summary: The main library on the Lincoln Park campus offering diverse study environments and resources.
cards.evidence_claim: After 9:00 p.m., access to the John T. Richardson Library is limited to current DePaul University students, staff.
cards.source_title: Access to Library Facilities - Chicago - DePaul University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Public access allowed before 9:00 PM; DePaul ID required for late-night entry.

cards.entity_name: Ray Meyer Fitness and Recreation Center
cards.title: Fitness at The Ray
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Park Campus
cards.notes: Access gym equipment, the pool, and group fitness classes like yoga or Zumba. Entry is included in the comprehensive student fee for all enrolled students.
cards.short_summary: A full-service fitness center available to DePaul students for recreation and wellness.
cards.evidence_claim: As part of DePaul's comprehensive fee, ALL DePaul University students will have access to the Ray Meyer Fitness & Recreation Center.
cards.source_title: Membership Types - Chicago - DePaul University Resources
cards.access_notes: DePaul ID required for entry; includes access to group classes.

cards.title: Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: DePaul Center, 11th Floor
cards.notes: Relax between classes in the Loop with comfortable seating, charging stations, and TVs. This space is specifically designed for students who commute.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated lounge space in the Loop for students to rest and recharge.
cards.evidence_claim: This lounge is equipped with comfortable seating, lots of electric plug-ins for charging, study tables, and televisions.
cards.source_title: Commuter Services - Student Affairs - DePaul University, Chicago
cards.access_notes: Open 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM; DePaul ID required.

cards.title: Chicago History Museum
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Park
cards.notes: Explore the city's past with free general admission by showing your DePaul ID. It is located just a short walk or bus ride from the Lincoln Park campus.
cards.short_summary: DePaul students get free entry to explore Chicago's cultural and historical heritage.
cards.evidence_claim: DePaul students, faculty and staff have the benefit of Free General Admission by presenting a current DePaul ID.
cards.source_title: A Top 5 Guide to Free Museum, Art and Discounts for DePaul Students | DeBlogs
cards.access_notes: Requires current DePaul Student ID for free general admission.

cards.title: Jarvis Student Center
cards.subtitle: DePaul Center
cards.notes: Collaborate in this modern hub for innovation and technology. It features a video wall and flexible spaces for interdisciplinary student projects.
cards.short_summary: A collaboration hub in the Loop campus for technology and design-focused students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jarvis Center is a hub for interdisciplinary collaboration, events and student community.
cards.source_title: Student Experience at the School of Design: Support, Spaces and Community Built for You
cards.access_notes: Located in the DePaul Center; accessible to students during building hours.

cards.title: Student Center Events
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Park Campus
cards.notes: Attend free movie nights, craft sessions, and involvement fairs hosted by the Office of Student Involvement. Check the DeHUB calendar for the latest schedule.
cards.short_summary: The primary venue for free student-led events and university programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Over the course of a year, a variety of events will typically be held in this building.
cards.source_title: Student Center - Lincoln Park Campus | Student Centers | DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Open daily; specific event times vary and are listed on DeHUB.
